claims.text: Self-consistency checking alone cannot effectively identify question-level hallucinations.
Self-consistency checking alone cannot effectively identify model-level hallucinations.
SAC3 incorporates semantically equivalent question perturbation to detect question-level hallucinations.
SAC3 incorporates cross-model response consistency checking to detect model-level hallucinations.
SAC3 outperforms the state of the art in detecting non-factual statements across multiple benchmarks.
SAC3 outperforms the state of the art in detecting factual statements across multiple benchmarks.

methodologies.name: Semantic-aware cross-check consistency (SAC3)
methodologies.description: A sampling-based method for hallucination detection that expands on self-consistency by using semantically equivalent question perturbation and cross-model response consistency checking.

limitations.text: Existing self-consistency check approaches cannot effectively identify question-level and model-level hallucinations.
